problems.statement_en: Given a set A of n points in the plane, no three collinear, show that we can find a set B of 2n - 5 points such that a point of B lies in the interior of every triangle whose vertices belong to A.

problems.statement_en: Suppose G is a connected graph with n edges. Prove that it is possible to label the edges of G from 1 to n in such a way that in every vertex v of G with two or more incident edges, the set of numbers labeling those edges has no common divisor greater than 1. (United States of America)
